message.content:
The entry data is loaded. For my MakerNote entry: format=7 (UNDEFINED, size 1), components=8, so s=8. Since s>4, doff = exif_get_long(d+offset+8). offset=10, so d+18 = the data offset field. My data has the offset field at bytes 18-21 = `1a 00 00 00` = 26. So doff=26. size=40. doff(26) < size(40), and s(8) <= size-doff(14). So entry->data is allocated with 8 bytes copied from d+26.

So the entry data is 8 bytes of 0xFF (from offset 26-33). This is NOT NUL-terminated. So when apple identify calls `strcmp((const char*)e->data, "Apple iOS")`, it reads past the 8-byte allocation.
